The '''O'reen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the planet [[O'reen]], homeworld of the [[O'reenian]]s.
